title: CAN FD Transmit
text: Transmit CAN FD message to selected CAN FD device, 1 input; {Device} sets the cAN FD device and channel, {On data change} enables event-based transmission when data, {Periodic} enables periodic transmission and {Transmit Options: Message period (in seconds)} sets the period of message transmission rate. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CAN Msg
ports.summary: CAN FD messages to transmit CAN_FD_MESSAGE_BUS

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN FD device and channel list option

params.name: On data change
params.values: Enable event-based transmission when data changes off (default) | on

params.name: Transmit Options: Message period (in seconds)
params.values: Period of message transmission rate 1.000 (default) | positive numeric scalar
